name: Fort Rock Data Center

profile.reading:
Fort Rock Data Center operates a colocation and managed services facility at 207 Southwest Columbia Street in Bend, Oregon, a high desert city on the eastern slope of the Cascade Range in Central Oregon that has grown quickly as a regional hub for outdoor recreation, breweries, and a small but expanding technology sector. The company markets the building as a purpose built, enterprise grade facility, positioning itself as a way for small and mid sized businesses, higher education institutions, healthcare and life sciences organizations, and government and municipal customers in the region to get enterprise level reliability without having to build or staff their own server rooms.

According to the operator's own site, the facility is built around geo redundant, distributed infrastructure with redundant power, cooling, and connectivity paths, energy efficient hot aisle containment, and carrier neutral network access, meaning customers can choose among multiple internet and network providers rather than being locked into one carrier. Fort Rock advertises a headline uptime figure of ninety nine point nine nine nine percent, commonly called five nines in the industry, and says the facility offers twenty four hour, seven day a week remote hands support so customers do not need staff on site to manage routine tasks. The company states its facility carries a SOC 2 Type 1 designation, a third party attestation that its internal controls around security and availability have been reviewed at a point in time, generally viewed as an earlier step toward the more rigorous SOC 2 Type II standard.

Beyond colocation, Fort Rock offers cloud services, managed IT, business continuity and disaster recovery planning, cybersecurity services, edge computing, and compliance support, a service mix aimed at regional customers who want a single local vendor for infrastructure and IT operations rather than assembling services from multiple national providers. What the company has not published is a founding date, ownership information, square footage, generator capacity, or a critical IT load figure in megawatts, details that are common for larger wholesale or hyperscale data centers but less commonly disclosed by small regional colocation operators whose sales process is built on direct conversations with prospective tenants rather than a public spec sheet.

reading:
Fort Rock Data Center is a small colocation and managed services provider operating from a single building at 207 SW Columbia Street in Bend, Oregon. County records now confirm the connection to Cascade Divide that had previously rested only on a commercial directory listing, and they also establish the scale of the site, which the operator itself does not publish.

The Deschutes County assessor records account 154896, map and taxlot 181206A070001, with a situs address of 207 SW Columbia Street, Bend, Oregon 97702. The legal description is Bend Tech Park Condominiums, Unit 1, and the property class is 302, industrial. The owner of record is Cascade Divide Partners LLC, with a mailing address of PO Box 1189, Mount Angel, Oregon. For the 2025 to 2026 tax year the assessor carries land at zero, structures at a real market value of 6,324,400 dollars, and both maximum assessed and assessed value at 2,817,520 dollars. Assessor acreage is recorded as zero because the property is a condominium unit rather than a platted lot, and a related account, 274544, covers the general and limited common elements of the same condominium. Fort Rock's own website gives the same street address, so the county record and the operator agree on location while naming different entities, one the titleholder and one the trading name.

The mapping history shows the usual pattern of a classification arriving long before any identification. The building polygon was drawn on 3 December 2019 with nothing but a building tag. A data centre telecom tag was added on 31 October 2022. Only on 20 April 2026 was the object given the name Fort Rock DC together with the street address, the operator name and the website. The data centre classification therefore preceded the operator attribution by more than three years.

Bend has more than one commercial data centre, and directories routinely conflate them. US Signal operates its OR01 Bend facility at 20845 Sockeye Place, Bend 97701, a different building at a different address with a different owner, and that site should not be merged into this record.

Fort Rock publishes colocation, cloud and managed services, SOC 2 Type 1 compliance, redundant power and cooling, carrier neutral connectivity with diverse fibre paths, round the clock facility oversight and a 99.999 percent uptime commitment. It does not publish a founding year, ownership or leadership detail, square footage, or any power figure. A previously carried figure of roughly 2 MW came from a commercial aggregator, is not supported by the operator or by the county, and is not repeated here. The assessed value of the structures is a useful indicator that this is a small facility, but it is a valuation, not a capacity, and no IT load, utility service, standby generation or on site generation figure is on the public record for this site.
